8th Grade · Unit 2 · Teen Life

Vocabulary Quiz

Test 1 / 3
Cevaplanan: 0 / 50

Doğru şıkkı işaretle. Cevabını değiştirebilirsin. Bitirince altta TESTİ BİTİR düğmesine bas. Menü ile başka bir teste geçebilirsin.

1Vocabulary Test 1 · Read each paragraph. Choose the correct word to complete the blank.

1

Ece and her brother disagree about a game. They speak angrily because each thinks the other is wrong. They sometimes ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: A) argue

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Ece and her brother disagree about a game. They speak angrily because each thinks the other is wrong.” Bu tarif “argue” kelimesine uyar; argue = tartışmak. Diğer şıklar: surf the Internet (internette gezinmek), go hiking (doğa yürüyüşüne çıkmak), prefer (tercih etmek).

2

Selin knows a useful website for learning guitar. She thinks her friend should try it too. She decides to ______ it.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: D) recommend

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Selin knows a useful website for learning guitar. She thinks her friend should try it too.” Bu tarif “recommend” kelimesine uyar; recommend = tavsiye etmek, önermek. Diğer şıklar: go shopping (alışverişe gitmek), text (mesaj atmak), go fishing (balık tutmaya gitmek).

3

Duru wants to publish regular online posts about her hobbies. She plans to put her own articles on a personal website. She decides to ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: A) write a blog

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Duru wants to publish regular online posts about her hobbies. She plans to put her own articles on a personal website.” Bu tarif “write a blog” kelimesine uyar; write a blog = blog yazmak. Diğer şıklar: enjoy (keyif almak), hang out (arkadaşlarla vakit geçirmek), go cycling (bisiklete binmek).

4

Elif takes a tent and a sleeping bag into the countryside. She sleeps outdoors rather than in a hotel. She likes to ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: C) go camping

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Elif takes a tent and a sleeping bag into the countryside. She sleeps outdoors rather than in a hotel.” Bu tarif “go camping” kelimesine uyar; go camping = kampa gitmek. Diğer şıklar: text (mesaj atmak), argue (tartışmak), recommend (tavsiye etmek, önermek).

5

Nehir takes a rod and bait to the lake. She waits by the water and tries to catch fish. She likes to ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: B) go fishing

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Nehir takes a rod and bait to the lake. She waits by the water and tries to catch fish.” Bu tarif “go fishing” kelimesine uyar; go fishing = balık tutmaya gitmek. Diğer şıklar: write a blog (blog yazmak), surf the Internet (internette gezinmek), go hiking (doğa yürüyüşüne çıkmak).

6

Sena needs new clothes and a school bag. She visits shops to choose and buy these things. She decides to ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: A) go shopping

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Sena needs new clothes and a school bag. She visits shops to choose and buy these things.” Bu tarif “go shopping” kelimesine uyar; go shopping = alışverişe gitmek. Diğer şıklar: hang out (arkadaşlarla vakit geçirmek), prefer (tercih etmek), go camping (kampa gitmek).

7

İpek feels happy when she reads adventure stories. Reading gives her pleasure rather than feeling like a duty. She says, "I ______ reading."

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: C) enjoy

Paragraftaki ipucu: “İpek feels happy when she reads adventure stories. Reading gives her pleasure rather than feeling like a duty.” Bu tarif “enjoy” kelimesine uyar; enjoy = keyif almak. Diğer şıklar: go cycling (bisiklete binmek), recommend (tavsiye etmek, önermek), argue (tartışmak).

8

Eylül reads a website with regular personal posts. The writer adds new articles about hobbies every week. This website is a ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: B) blog

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Eylül reads a website with regular personal posts. The writer adds new articles about hobbies every week.” Bu tarif “blog” kelimesine uyar; blog = blog. Diğer şıklar: blogger (blog yazarı), band (müzik grubu), documentary (belgesel).

9

Cemre buys a ticket to hear live music. Singers and musicians perform on a stage for an audience. She attends a ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: D) concert

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Cemre buys a ticket to hear live music. Singers and musicians perform on a stage for an audience.” Bu tarif “concert” kelimesine uyar; concert = konser. Diğer şıklar: gym (spor salonu), teenager (genç, ergen), snob (züppe, kendini beğenmiş).

10

Melis finishes her homework and household tasks. She has an hour with no duties and can choose what to do. This is her ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: A) free time

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Melis finishes her homework and household tasks. She has an hour with no duties and can choose what to do.” Bu tarif “free time” kelimesine uyar; free time = boş vakit. Diğer şıklar: online games (çevrimiçi oyunlar), relationship (ilişki), fantasy (fantastik tür).

11

Sıla collects stamps because she enjoys it. She does this activity in her spare time rather than as a job. It is her ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: B) hobby

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Sıla collects stamps because she enjoys it. She does this activity in her spare time rather than as a job.” Bu tarif “hobby” kelimesine uyar; hobby = hobi, uğraş. Diğer şıklar: fashion (moda), detective (polisiye), science fiction (bilim kurgu).

12

Defne describes a character who thinks expensive possessions make people superior. The character looks down on people with less money. The character is a ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: C) snob

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Defne describes a character who thinks expensive possessions make people superior. The character looks down on people with less money.” Bu tarif “snob” kelimesine uyar; snob = züppe, kendini beğenmiş. Diğer şıklar: romance (aşk romanı), documentary (belgesel), concert (konser).

13

Buse plays digital games with friends in other cities. Their devices connect through the Internet while they play together. They enjoy ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: D) online games

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Buse plays digital games with friends in other cities. Their devices connect through the Internet while they play together.” Bu tarif “online games” kelimesine uyar; online games = çevrimiçi oyunlar. Diğer şıklar: free time (boş vakit), fantasy (fantastik tür), teenager (genç, ergen).

14

İdil reads a story about a mysterious theft. An investigator follows clues to find the person responsible. She enjoys ______ stories.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: B) detective

Paragraftaki ipucu: “İdil reads a story about a mysterious theft. An investigator follows clues to find the person responsible.” Bu tarif “detective” kelimesine uyar; detective = polisiye. Diğer şıklar: blogger (blog yazarı), relationship (ilişki), band (müzik grubu).

15

Zeynep enjoys stories about future technology and journeys to distant planets. The imagined inventions are important to these stories. She likes ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: D) science fiction

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Zeynep enjoys stories about future technology and journeys to distant planets. The imagined inventions are important to these stories.” Bu tarif “science fiction” kelimesine uyar; science fiction = bilim kurgu. Diğer şıklar: blog (blog), hobby (hobi, uğraş), gym (spor salonu).

16

Mina listens to an orchestra performing a Mozart symphony. She enjoys compositions written for instruments such as violins and cellos. She likes ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: C) classical music

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Mina listens to an orchestra performing a Mozart symphony. She enjoys compositions written for instruments such as violins and cellos.” Bu tarif “classical music” kelimesine uyar; classical music = klasik müzik. Diğer şıklar: heavy metal (heavy metal müzik türü), pop music (pop müzik), rap (rap müziği).

17

Pelin enjoys songs built around electric guitars, bass and a strong drum beat. She likes energetic guitar bands. Her favourite genre is ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: A) rock music

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Pelin enjoys songs built around electric guitars, bass and a strong drum beat. She likes energetic guitar bands.” Bu tarif “rock music” kelimesine uyar; rock music = rock müziği. Diğer şıklar: jazz (caz müziği), romance (aşk romanı), fantasy (fantastik tür).

18

Derya enjoys traditional songs passed down through generations. These songs reflect the customs and culture of a community. She likes ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: D) folk music

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Derya enjoys traditional songs passed down through generations. These songs reflect the customs and culture of a community.” Bu tarif “folk music” kelimesine uyar; folk music = halk müziği. Diğer şıklar: pop music (pop müzik), heavy metal (heavy metal müzik türü), classical music (klasik müzik).

19

Sena enjoys music linked to a culture that includes DJing and breakdancing. Rhythmic beats are central to the style. She likes ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: C) hip-hop

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Sena enjoys music linked to a culture that includes DJing and breakdancing. Rhythmic beats are central to the style.” Bu tarif “hip-hop” kelimesine uyar; hip-hop = hip-hop müzik türü. Diğer şıklar: rock music (rock müziği), jazz (caz müziği), romance (aşk romanı).

20

Eda loses interest in a very slow film. Nothing in the story holds her attention, and she wants it to end. She finds it ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: B) boring

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Eda loses interest in a very slow film. Nothing in the story holds her attention, and she wants it to end.” Bu tarif “boring” kelimesine uyar; boring = sıkıcı. Diğer şıklar: relaxing (rahatlatıcı, dinlendirici), trendy (son moda), enjoyable (keyifli, eğlenceli).

21

Cem enjoys films set in earlier periods of human history. The costumes, buildings and events reflect a particular period. He likes ______ films.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: A) historical

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Cem enjoys films set in earlier periods of human history. The costumes, buildings and events reflect a particular period.” Bu tarif “historical” kelimesine uyar; historical = tarihi. Diğer şıklar: loud (yüksek sesli), educational (eğitsel), smart (şık).

22

Eren watches a very skilled musician perform a difficult piece perfectly. He feels admiration for the musician's ability. The performance is ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: C) impressive

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Eren watches a very skilled musician perform a difficult piece perfectly. He feels admiration for the musician's ability.” Bu tarif “impressive” kelimesine uyar; impressive = etkileyici. Diğer şıklar: biographical (biyografik), ridiculous (saçma, gülünç), unbearable (dayanılmaz, çekilmez).

23

Baran listens to gentle music after a tiring day. It helps him feel calm and peaceful. He finds it ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: A) relaxing

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Baran listens to gentle music after a tiring day. It helps him feel calm and peaceful.” Bu tarif “relaxing” kelimesine uyar; relaxing = rahatlatıcı, dinlendirici. Diğer şıklar: trendy (son moda), boring (sıkıcı), loud (yüksek sesli).

24

Tolga changes out of his everyday T-shirt before a formal event. His neat jacket and formal trousers look stylish. His clothes are ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: B) smart

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Tolga changes out of his everyday T-shirt before a formal event. His neat jacket and formal trousers look stylish.” Bu tarif “smart” kelimesine uyar; smart = şık. Diğer şıklar: impressive (etkileyici), historical (tarihi), enjoyable (keyifli, eğlenceli).

25

Ozan cannot tolerate an extremely unpleasant noise. It is so difficult to put up with that he leaves the room. He finds it ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: D) unbearable

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Ozan cannot tolerate an extremely unpleasant noise. It is so difficult to put up with that he leaves the room.” Bu tarif “unbearable” kelimesine uyar; unbearable = dayanılmaz, çekilmez. Diğer şıklar: educational (eğitsel), biographical (biyografik), ridiculous (saçma, gülünç).

2Vocabulary Test 2 · Read each paragraph. Choose the correct word to complete the blank.

1

Mert likes both films and books. However, he likes books more and chooses them when he has a choice. He says, "I ______ books to films."

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: A) prefer

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Mert likes both films and books. However, he likes books more and chooses them when he has a choice.” Bu tarif “prefer” kelimesine uyar; prefer = tercih etmek. Diğer şıklar: go cycling (bisiklete binmek), hang out (arkadaşlarla vakit geçirmek), go shopping (alışverişe gitmek).

2

Bora does not want to make a voice call. He types a short message on his mobile phone. He chooses to ______ his friend.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: D) text

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Bora does not want to make a voice call. He types a short message on his mobile phone.” Bu tarif “text” kelimesine uyar; text = mesaj atmak. Diğer şıklar: recommend (tavsiye etmek, önermek), argue (tartışmak), enjoy (keyif almak).

3

Arda visits different websites in his free time. He browses pages about sport, music and travel. He likes to ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: B) surf the Internet

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Arda visits different websites in his free time. He browses pages about sport, music and travel.” Bu tarif “surf the Internet” kelimesine uyar; surf the Internet = internette gezinmek. Diğer şıklar: write a blog (blog yazmak), go camping (kampa gitmek), go fishing (balık tutmaya gitmek).

4

Can puts on a helmet and gets on his bicycle. He pedals along a safe path beside the river. He likes to ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: A) go cycling

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Can puts on a helmet and gets on his bicycle. He pedals along a safe path beside the river.” Bu tarif “go cycling” kelimesine uyar; go cycling = bisiklete binmek. Diğer şıklar: enjoy (keyif almak), go shopping (alışverişe gitmek), recommend (tavsiye etmek, önermek).

5

Emir wears walking boots and follows a mountain path. He enjoys long walks in natural areas. He likes to ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: C) go hiking

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Emir wears walking boots and follows a mountain path. He enjoys long walks in natural areas.” Bu tarif “go hiking” kelimesine uyar; go hiking = doğa yürüyüşüne çıkmak. Diğer şıklar: write a blog (blog yazmak), prefer (tercih etmek), text (mesaj atmak).

6

Baran meets his friends after school with no special plan. They chat and relax together in the park. They like to ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: D) hang out

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Baran meets his friends after school with no special plan. They chat and relax together in the park.” Bu tarif “hang out” kelimesine uyar; hang out = arkadaşlarla vakit geçirmek. Diğer şıklar: go fishing (balık tutmaya gitmek), argue (tartışmak), surf the Internet (internette gezinmek).

7

Tolga listens to four musicians who perform together. One sings, two play guitars and one plays the drums. They form a ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: B) band

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Tolga listens to four musicians who perform together. One sings, two play guitars and one plays the drums.” Bu tarif “band” kelimesine uyar; band = müzik grubu. Diğer şıklar: teenager (genç, ergen), documentary (belgesel), fantasy (fantastik tür).

8

Ozan publishes new posts on his personal website. He writes regularly about his own interests and experiences. He is a ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: C) blogger

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Ozan publishes new posts on his personal website. He writes regularly about his own interests and experiences.” Bu tarif “blogger” kelimesine uyar; blogger = blog yazarı. Diğer şıklar: free time (boş vakit), snob (züppe, kendini beğenmiş), online games (çevrimiçi oyunlar).

9

Yusuf follows new styles of clothes and accessories. He likes knowing which designs are currently popular. He is interested in ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: A) fashion

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Yusuf follows new styles of clothes and accessories. He likes knowing which designs are currently popular.” Bu tarif “fashion” kelimesine uyar; fashion = moda. Diğer şıklar: blog (blog), hobby (hobi, uğraş), concert (konser).

10

Aras wants to exercise indoors. He visits a place with training machines and weights. He goes to the ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: D) gym

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Aras wants to exercise indoors. He visits a place with training machines and weights.” Bu tarif “gym” kelimesine uyar; gym = spor salonu. Diğer şıklar: detective (polisiye), romance (aşk romanı), science fiction (bilim kurgu).

11

Gökçe is sixteen years old. She belongs to the age group from thirteen to nineteen. She is a ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: B) teenager

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Gökçe is sixteen years old. She belongs to the age group from thirteen to nineteen.” Bu tarif “teenager” kelimesine uyar; teenager = genç, ergen. Diğer şıklar: blog (blog), online games (çevrimiçi oyunlar), band (müzik grubu).

12

Kerem and his cousin have a close connection. They communicate often and understand each other. They have a good ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: C) relationship

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Kerem and his cousin have a close connection. They communicate often and understand each other.” Bu tarif “relationship” kelimesine uyar; relationship = ilişki. Diğer şıklar: gym (spor salonu), blogger (blog yazarı), fashion (moda).

13

Deniz watches a programme about real ocean animals. It presents facts and real-life footage rather than a made-up story. It is a ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: A) documentary

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Deniz watches a programme about real ocean animals. It presents facts and real-life footage rather than a made-up story.” Bu tarif “documentary” kelimesine uyar; documentary = belgesel. Diğer şıklar: detective (polisiye), snob (züppe, kendini beğenmiş), hobby (hobi, uğraş).

14

Onur reads a novel mainly about two people falling in love. Their feelings and romantic relationship are central to the story. It is a ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: B) romance

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Onur reads a novel mainly about two people falling in love. Their feelings and romantic relationship are central to the story.” Bu tarif “romance” kelimesine uyar; romance = aşk romanı. Diğer şıklar: free time (boş vakit), science fiction (bilim kurgu), relationship (ilişki).

15

Arda reads about magical creatures and enchanted kingdoms. Magic, rather than scientific invention, shapes this imaginary world. He likes ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: A) fantasy

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Arda reads about magical creatures and enchanted kingdoms. Magic, rather than scientific invention, shapes this imaginary world.” Bu tarif “fantasy” kelimesine uyar; fantasy = fantastik tür. Diğer şıklar: concert (konser), blog (blog), online games (çevrimiçi oyunlar).

16

Ali enjoys catchy songs that appear in current music charts. Their tunes are easy to remember and popular with a wide audience. He likes ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: C) pop music

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Ali enjoys catchy songs that appear in current music charts. Their tunes are easy to remember and popular with a wide audience.” Bu tarif “pop music” kelimesine uyar; pop music = pop müzik. Diğer şıklar: rock music (rock müziği), folk music (halk müziği), hip-hop (hip-hop müzik türü).

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: D) jazz

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Efe listens to a group with a saxophone, piano and double bass. The players improvise and create new musical phrases as they perform.” Bu tarif “jazz” kelimesine uyar; jazz = caz müziği. Diğer şıklar: classical music (klasik müzik), science fiction (bilim kurgu), fantasy (fantastik tür).

18

Berk likes songs with rhythmic spoken verses. The performer delivers rhyming words over a beat rather than singing a melody throughout. He likes ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: A) rap

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Berk likes songs with rhythmic spoken verses. The performer delivers rhyming words over a beat rather than singing a melody throughout.” Bu tarif “rap” kelimesine uyar; rap = rap müziği. Diğer şıklar: pop music (pop müzik), folk music (halk müziği), rock music (rock müziği).

19

Burak likes a very heavy guitar sound, powerful drumming and intense vocals. He follows bands associated with metal music. He enjoys ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: B) heavy metal

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Burak likes a very heavy guitar sound, powerful drumming and intense vocals. He follows bands associated with metal music.” Bu tarif “heavy metal” kelimesine uyar; heavy metal = heavy metal müzik türü. Diğer şıklar: classical music (klasik müzik), hip-hop (hip-hop müzik türü), jazz (caz müziği).

20

Tuna watches a programme that teaches useful facts. It helps viewers learn new information and skills. The programme is ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: C) educational

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Tuna watches a programme that teaches useful facts. It helps viewers learn new information and skills.” Bu tarif “educational” kelimesine uyar; educational = eğitsel. Diğer şıklar: impressive (etkileyici), boring (sıkıcı), relaxing (rahatlatıcı, dinlendirici).

21

Aylin watches a film about the life of a real writer. It follows important events in that person's life. The film is ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: D) biographical

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Aylin watches a film about the life of a real writer. It follows important events in that person's life.” Bu tarif “biographical” kelimesine uyar; biographical = biyografik. Diğer şıklar: trendy (son moda), enjoyable (keyifli, eğlenceli), unbearable (dayanılmaz, çekilmez).

22

Nehir turns down the speakers because the volume is too high. The sound makes it hard to hear a conversation. The music is ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: A) loud

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Nehir turns down the speakers because the volume is too high. The sound makes it hard to hear a conversation.” Bu tarif “loud” kelimesine uyar; loud = yüksek sesli. Diğer şıklar: smart (şık), historical (tarihi), educational (eğitsel).

23

İpek hears a plan that makes no sense at all. It is so silly and unreasonable that she laughs at it. She calls it ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: D) ridiculous

Paragraftaki ipucu: “İpek hears a plan that makes no sense at all. It is so silly and unreasonable that she laughs at it.” Bu tarif “ridiculous” kelimesine uyar; ridiculous = saçma, gülünç. Diğer şıklar: relaxing (rahatlatıcı, dinlendirici), impressive (etkileyici), boring (sıkıcı).

24

Eylül buys a jacket in a style that is very popular right now. She likes following the latest clothing designs. The jacket is ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: C) trendy

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Eylül buys a jacket in a style that is very popular right now. She likes following the latest clothing designs.” Bu tarif “trendy” kelimesine uyar; trendy = son moda. Diğer şıklar: historical (tarihi), unbearable (dayanılmaz, çekilmez), loud (yüksek sesli).

25

Cemre feels happy during a board-game evening. The activity gives her pleasure, and she wants to do it again. It is ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: B) enjoyable

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Cemre feels happy during a board-game evening. The activity gives her pleasure, and she wants to do it again.” Bu tarif “enjoyable” kelimesine uyar; enjoyable = keyifli, eğlenceli. Diğer şıklar: biographical (biyografik), ridiculous (saçma, gülünç), smart (şık).

3Vocabulary Quiz 50 · Choose the correct Turkish meaning of each word. (Her kelimenin doğru Türkçe anlamını seçiniz.)

1

argue

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: A) tartışmak

“argue” ifadesinin Türkçe anlamı “tartışmak” olur. Bu ifade “Boş zaman etkinlikleri” grubundandır. Örnek: My brothers argue about the TV.

2
